scope: Visual inspection of the three anonymous hosted installer screenshots generated by preview-installer.json; not a physical-phone installation test.

screenshots.review: ReportFlow branding, language controls, browser entry, iPhone/Android instructions, QR, Copy link and PDF/PNG/SVG download controls are readable. Cards and text fit the phone width without overlap or horizontal overflow. Account and pending-Report safety guidance is visible.

Chinese headings, body text and action labels render with intact glyphs and natural line wrapping. Branding, instructions, QR and downloads remain clear and within the phone-width cards. No clipping of control labels or overlapping text is visible.
The cold-offline screenshot is byte-identical to the English online capture. Logo, QR, layout, instructions and controls remain present and legible after every previous page was closed.

automatedChecks.installerAssetParity: Seven artifacts match frozen local SHA-256 and expected MIME types.
automatedChecks.phoneWidth: 390px document width with no horizontal overflow in English, Chinese and offline captures.
automatedChecks.coldOffline: The exact installer and cached logo/QR are served by the shared service worker.
automatedChecks.isolation: No protected request, page error, native installation prompt or service-worker activation message.

limits: Anonymous static-only inspection; no backend account, Report, invitation or other production data was accessed or changed.
Native installation, QR scanning and physical iOS/Android rendering remain unverified.
